# edgeos_firewall_name (Resource)

An IPv4 firewall rule set (`firewall name <name>`). Rules are managed with `edgeos_firewall_rule`; this resource only owns the rule set's own settings and never touches its rules on update.

Destroying the rule set deletes the whole node, including any rules that Terraform does not manage. EdgeOS refuses to delete a rule set that an interface still references, so detach it first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_firewall_name" "wan_in" {
  name           = "WAN_IN"
  description    = "Internet to LAN"
  default_action = "drop"
}

resource "edgeos_firewall_name" "wan_local" {
  name               = "WAN_LOCAL"
  description        = "Internet to the router"
  default_action     = "drop"
  enable_default_log = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule set name, such as `WAN_IN`. Changing it creates a new rule set.

### Optional

- `default_action` (String) What happens to packets no rule matches: `drop`, `reject` or `accept`. Defaults to `drop`.
- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `enable_default_log` (Boolean) Log packets handled by the default action. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule set name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_firewall_name.wan_in WAN_IN
```
